verification.visualInspection: Chromium custom bar and visible records inspected after centering clear of the documentation header

review.correctness: Seventeen native cases per engine include pointer cancellation, custom parts, viewport transfer, finite geometry, RTL and native wheel boundary release
review.architecture: Uses the existing state, motion, Button and composed-ownership mechanisms; no Zag runtime or virtualizer owner added
review.security: No data fetching, raw HTML property rendering or storage; step values use native CSS validation
review.performance: One frame-coalesced measurement path; observers update only their changed target set; idle timer and pointer resources release

reference.zag: Published 1.44.0 machine/connect/DOM/types and scroll helpers read in full
reference.nativeKeyboard: Plain WebKit native controls also fail the zero-duration automated ArrowDown press; a held 100ms press scrolls both. No replacement key handler added.
reference.virtualization: Real @tanstack/lit-virtual 3.14.0 consumer scrolls to row 500 while rendering fewer than 25 rows, using getViewport as the native scroll owner
reference.minimumThumb: 24 CSS pixels along the track, capped to track length; zero travel preserves position
reference.visibilityDelay: Internal 1000ms recent-scroll visibility follows the inspected behavior source; no extra public delay API
